@thsottiaux @ajambrosino I like Dot now.

I asked Codex in Chrome to check reviews for a power bank on Amazon couple days ago. That was it. No follow-up, no task for my Dot.

Today, Dot randomly messaged me with a better deal from Anker UK. so it found me a discount code without me asking!!!!!! 

What surprised me wasn't that Dot remembered what I was looking at. It was that it seemed to infer what I was trying to achieve, and proactively took a step that could benefit me — without me ever asking it to.

I barely use Dot, but this genuinely surprised me.

A small glimpse of what personal AI could become.

note_tweet.text:
An always-on agent isn’t very useful if you can’t tell whether it’s actually doing anything.

My Dot was explaining what we needed to work on for my harness, so I thought it was continuing.

When I asked if it was working, it told me it had stopped.

I don’t need every tool call sent to my phone, but I do need to know when it’s working, blocked or waiting on me.

I shouldn’t have to keep asking “you’re working?” to find out.
